intended_object: The tautological 1-hypercover of X associated with a covering sieve S ∈ J(X): level-0 cover is all arrows in S, level-1 covers are all commutative squares (W, p₁, p₂) over pairs of arrows of S. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The body uses S.preOneHypercover, whose I₀ is S.Arrow (objects f.Y, maps f.f) and whose I₁ f₁ f₂ is f₁.Relation f₂ (all commutative squares Z with g₁, g₂ and w : g₁ ≫ f₁.f = g₂ ≫ f₂.f). This is exactly what the docstring describes. mem₀ holds because the generated sieve equals S (preOneHypercover_sieve₀). mem₁ holds because every level-1 sieve is ⊤ (preOneHypercover_sieve₁). The construction is stated for an arbitrary Grothendieck topology on an arbitrary category, which is its natural generality. It is a canonical construction, correctly formalized.
